text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, Yaeno. I've come to 
fulfill our promise."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Still... is it really all right? Everyone 
said they could never keep up with my 
speed—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm asking knowing full well what I'm 
getting into!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
At the turn of a new year, to surpass 
one's past self and seek new heights, 
imposing trials upon oneself is a 
necessity.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even if I fall short, I will pursue you 
relentlessly. I would be honored to 
receive your guidance, Oguri-san!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. I was worried that I might 
cause you distress on such a celebratory 
day, but—"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: If you are prepared for that—let's go.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I asked the staff to serve you the same 
portion I usually have. I hope you will 
take on the challenge with all your might.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! To build a more robust body, I hope 
to follow Oguri-san's appetite as an 
example!
